missingDetails: Legacy record: authored localized details and tradeoffs are unavailable.
customHint: Literal response, 1–1000 Unicode characters. Nothing is sent until confirmation.
customInvalid: Enter nonempty text of at most 1000 Unicode characters.
customRecorded: Custom response recorded for firstmate to interpret.
orderFailed: Order not acknowledged. Check the connection and decision state before retrying.
eventFailed: Decision saved, but its event could not be logged.
capReady: Cutlass half drawn — confirm your choice
ahoyDemo: Demonstrate the salute (no event is recorded)
orderDemo: Demonstrate an order acknowledgement (no event is recorded)
dragHint: drag a figure to turn it · drag the deck to turn the whole crew · double-click resets
dropZone: Drag a card here to drop it
dropConfirm: Drop {id}? It leaves the lanes and will not be done; its spec in design/tasks/ is unchanged.
actionFailed: The board could not record that. Refresh and try again.
mergeUnknown: merge outcome unknown: GitHub could not be read, this project's next merge waits
mergeBusy: not sent: a merge is already running in this project; the card stays pending
readOnly: This tab is read-only: only the tab the board was opened in holds the captain's sign-in. Ask firstmate to reopen the board to answer cards and move tasks here.
writeCredential: not sent: this tab is read-only; ask firstmate to reopen the board
writeOrigin: not sent: the request did not come from the board's own page
writeJson: not sent: the board takes JSON only
loginRefused: that sign-in link is wrong, used or expired; ask firstmate to reopen the board
parkConfirm: Park {id}? It leaves the lanes until you unpark it.
crewStopNote: Its crew aboard ({crew}) will be stopped now.
prStaysOpen: Its pull request {pr} stays open; nothing closes it without you.
reopenConfirm: {id} shows as {stage}. Reopen it only if that is wrong: it goes where its later events put it, and the reopening stays in the log.
finalNote: {task} is already {stage}. Check that this card belongs to it before you answer.
effectRefused: the answer is recorded, but its effect failed
parkConfirmCaptain: Park {id}? Its card is still waiting for you, so it stays in your lane until the card is answered or withdrawn; after that it leaves the lanes until you unpark it.
confirmRequired: not done: this task has crew aboard or an open pull request; choose it again and confirm
reopenNeedsReason: not reopened: say why it is wrong, in one line of plain text
